clue.text: Very easily workers are dejected

parts.note: hands are manual workers, as in farm hands
to be down is to be low in spirits

explanation.surface: Labourers are miserable, and that comes about without any effort.
explanation.definitionFit: To win comfortably, with no struggle at all, is to win in the idiom 'with hands lowered'.

clue.text: So leap to be on the decline

indicators.note: the letters of the words before are made to become something else, a loose signal to rearrange them

explanation.surface: A jump that ends up taking someone downhill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be' is a weak anagram signal: SOLEAP becomes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something on a slant, tilted downward, lies at an angle like a hillside.

clue.text: Delicacy coming out of tin within 24 hours

indicators.note: within says one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a day lasts twenty-four hours

indicators.note: the word tin emerges in a new form, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A treat being taken out of a can sometime during the day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming out of' is the anagram signal on 'tin', and 'within' places the result inside the 24 hours; 'Delicacy' is a noun here, not the adjective it suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun the word means a choice morsel or titbit, a synonym of delicacy.

clue.text: Double dagger that is found in Diss, strangely enough

indicators.note: found in says one piece is placed inside the other
the town name Diss appears in an odd form, its letters rearranged

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A dagger turning up oddly in the Norfolk town of Diss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strangely enough' rearranges the town's name and 'found in' sets 'that is' inside it. Diss is a market town in Norfolk; the double dagger is a printer's reference mark.
explanation.definitionFit: In typography the diesis is the name for the double obelus reference mark, ‡.

clue.text: An elementary prognostication

parts.note: elementary here means concerning the elements, wind and rain and sun, and a prognostication is a prediction

explanation.definitionFit: A forecast of the weather predicts what the elements will do.

clue.text: Instrumentalist on the beach might take flight

definitions.text: Instrumentalist on the beach might take flight

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above the next piece

parts.note: sand covers a beach
a piper plays the pipes

explanation.surface: A musician playing by the sea who might run off.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue describes a wading bird of the shore that may fly off, while also building it from its parts.
explanation.definitionFit: This shore bird is a small wader seen on beaches, which flies up when disturbed.

clue.text: Set to stare at an evergreen shrub

parts.note: to goggle is to stare wide-eyed
box is an evergreen shrub used for hedging

explanation.surface: Gardener preparing to gaze at a shrub.
explanation.walkthrough: GOGGLE-BOX is British slang for the television.
explanation.definitionFit: A television is a TV set, and this slang name says viewers stare at it.

clue.text: Norma made other notes

indicators.note: other asks for a different arrangement of the letters before it

explanation.surface: A woman called Norma wrote some more reminders.
explanation.definitionFit: These are written reminders or records, the plural of a Latin word for something to be remembered.

clue.text: Convict returns raw material in abundance

indicators.note: returns says the word for convict is read backwards

parts.note: a lag is slang for a convict
ore is rock mined as raw material for metal

explanation.surface: A prisoner going back with plenty of ore to work.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming after its noun, the word means plentiful, in great quantity.

clue.text: Stingy with lira I'll be exchanging

indicators.note: exchanging the currency suggests the letters are swapped about

parts.note: the apostrophe is ignored

explanation.surface: Someone mean, swapping Italian lira at a bureau.
explanation.definitionFit: Narrow-minded or mean-spirited, ungenerous in outlook or with money.

clue.text: I go round after the girl slowly

indicators.note: after says the second piece comes behind the girl

parts.note: Ada is a girl's name

indicators.note: round means the letters are turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone trailing a girl at a leisurely pace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' rearranges 'I go', and 'after' puts that behind the girl's name; 'slowly' is the musical direction.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction, Italian for at ease, telling players to perform at a slow tempo.

clue.text: Draw attention to the stage illumination

definitions.meaning: to highlight or focus attention on something
a strong beam lamp trained on a performer

explanation.definitionFit: The lamp that picks out a performer on stage also, as a verb, means to single out for notice.

clue.text: Came in dishevelled for entertainment

indicators.note: dishevelled means messed up, so the letters are disordered

explanation.surface: Someone arrived untidy for a night out.
explanation.definitionFit: Going to the pictures, watching films, is a form of amusement.

clue.text: Unusually fine story, too overwhelming to be expressed in words

definitions.text: too overwhelming to be expressed in words

indicators.note: unusually says the word fine appears in a strange order

parts.note: a fable is a short moral story

explanation.surface: A remarkably good tale that leaves listeners speechless.
explanation.definitionFit: Something beyond description is so great that no language can capture it.

clue.text: Ascribe a characteristic quality

definitions.meaning: to credit something to a source or cause
a feature or trait belonging to someone

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to credit or assign; as a noun, a trait, with the stress shifting.

clue.text: Forthright, like soap-box orator?

definitions.meaning: a street speaker on a box speaks out in public, a cryptic reading

explanation.definitionFit: Being candid and blunt is speaking out, as a soap-box speaker literally does.

clue.text: Bachelor accepts redhead's undergarment

indicators.note: accepts says the bachelor takes another piece inside

parts.note: BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a bachelor's degree
the head of red, its first letter, is R

explanation.surface: A single man takes a red-haired woman's lingerie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'redhead's' is read as the head of 'red', R; 'accepts' places it inside BA.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a supporting garment worn under clothing, a brassiere.

clue.text: Window at the front of the ship?

definitions.meaning: a curved bay window projecting from a wall

definitions.text: at the front of the ship?
definitions.meaning: the forward end of a vessel

explanation.definitionFit: A curved projecting window is named for its arc; the forward part of a vessel is its prow.

clue.text: A note for the goddess

parts.note: te is the seventh note of the tonic sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A musical tone written for a deity.
explanation.walkthrough: Ate is the Greek goddess of mischief and ruin.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth, the deity of folly and rash action leading to ruin.

clue.text: Still in danger in the 21

definitions.meaning: not yet safe, still facing trouble
21 is the answer to 21 across, the trees, so this reads as inside the trees

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for not yet clear of difficulty literally places someone still among the trees.

clue.text: Grief is said to stop a horse

indicators.note: is said says the word is heard spoken

parts.note: whoa is the call to stop a horse

explanation.surface: Sorrow when someone halts their mount.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep sorrow or distress is a synonym of grief.

clue.text: Anticipate everybody leaving the wooded area

indicators.note: leaving says one word departs from the other

parts.note: to forestall is to act ahead of, anticipate
all means everybody

explanation.surface: Expecting everyone to depart from the woods.
explanation.definitionFit: A large area covered with trees is a wood on a grand scale.

clue.text: It is clear Lulu loses half the money

indicators.note: losing half the name leaves only its first two letters

parts.note: a cent is a coin, a unit of money

explanation.surface: Lulu has plainly lost half her cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loses half' keeps LU from LULU; 'It is' links.
explanation.definitionFit: Shining or translucent, letting light through, so transparent.

clue.text: Percival lumbered partly by an old earthwork

indicators.note: partly says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A man named Percival trudged past an ancient bank.
explanation.walkthrough: A vallum is a Roman rampart, as along Hadrian's Wall.
explanation.definitionFit: The Romans built this rampart of earth as a defensive ditch and bank.

clue.text: It doesn't sound as if one is able to get the bird

definitions.text: It doesn't sound as if one is able to get the bird

parts.words: It doesn't sound as if one is able to get the bird
parts.note: said aloud, the bird's name sounds like two being able, not one

explanation.definitionFit: This tropical bird with a huge bill has a name that sounds like a pair can.

clue.text: Controlling device to be in, eluded at frequent intervals

indicators.note: be included says the small word goes inside the other

parts.note: regular means occurring at steady, frequent intervals

explanation.surface: A control device being fitted in at steady intervals.
explanation.definitionFit: A mechanism that governs flow or speed, such as a valve or governor.

clue.text: West Bromwich, a team of Rovers in Scotland!

definitions.meaning: West Bromwich ... is an English football club

definitions.text: a team of Rovers in Scotland
definitions.meaning: ... Rovers is a Scottish football club

explanation.walkthrough: Both are football clubs: West Bromwich in England, the Rovers in Coatbridge, Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: The name, an old poetic word for Britain, completes both a Midlands club and a Coatbridge club.

clue.text: Happen to finish in the first three

definitions.text: to finish in the first three
definitions.meaning: in racing, finishing second or third, a placing

explanation.walkthrough: In British racing a horse that is 'placed' finishes in the first three.
explanation.definitionFit: To occur is the idiom's usual sense; literally, it means to earn a placing in a race.

clue.text: Untidy young animals

definitions.meaning: to make a place messy by scattering rubbish
a brood of young born at one time

explanation.definitionFit: Scattered rubbish makes a place untidy; a brood of puppies or kittens shares the same word.

clue.text: New Testament account

indicators.note: new suggests a fresh arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: A report on the New Testament.
explanation.definitionFit: A report or record of facts is a written account.
